content: Solemoo Banya Ikinyingi Dusipa Pipya Kumuyami Doko

Yuu kyau Gilipoa dokona Pilisitia wambu dupwame Isaraele wambu dupwa pyala epeyamisa yanda piyami. Piyaminyi dokopa Isaraele wambu malu dokona pyao kumakayami dee lapo ralo pyako peyami. Peyaminyi dokona kiŋi Sole dee banya ikinyingi dupwape opetae pyako peyami.
Dopa pyuo peyaminyipape Pilisitia wambu dupwame nakama minyarapala nyuo Solena ikinyingi rema dusipa Jonatanemoo Apinatapemoo dee Malikisua paleta pyao kumakayami.
Yanda andake pipala Sole baa yanda pimwainya waleka dupwame pisipala kopetame ranjama epeya. Wane parange mendeme banya yanda pingi bange dupwa soo peyamo doko kando lao,

Pilisitia wambu Anatu suu pyaa nange dupwame male male lao pyao kumaka narami lao embena wua gela doko neta nyepala namba pyao kumakape, leya. Dopa leyamopape wanyane akali dokome apa pyuo pyaro lao soo mona nembo kareya. Dokopa Sole banya wua gela nyepala baa range pyao kumakaya.
Wanyane akali doko Sole range banya wua gela dokome pyao kumakayamo doko kandapala banya wua gela doko nyepala baa range pyao kumakapala Solepa role pyao kumuya.
Solemoo banya ikinyingi rema dusipa pipya wanyane akali dokomoo dopa pyuo kumuyami. Solena akali dusipa peparae yuu gii mendaki dokona kumuyami.

Isaraele wambu lapo Jeserele pau pakirena karo dee ipwa Jotane pona neta epenge dorena kareyami dupwame Solemoo banya ikinyingi dupwamoo piyaminyi dokopa Isaraele yanda singi menge dupwa ralo peyami doko leyaminyi siyami. Sepala nakamana yuu taone dupwa yaki nyuo ralo peyami. Peyaminyi dokopa Pilisitia wambu dupwa taone dupwana epo paleyami.

Yanda pyuo palenge yangama dokopa Pilisitia wambu dupwa yuu kyau Gilipoa dokona akali pyasi siyami dupwana bange keyange lapo paleta siyamo dupwa waa nyela peyami. Pao Sole baape ikinyingi rema dusipape yuu kyau Gilipoa dokona kumasi siyaminyi dupwa kando nyiyami.

Nyepala Solena mange doko pyao pukupala banya yanda pingi bange dupwa roko nyiyami. Nyepala pii wai minyingi akali lapome bange dupwa nyuo minyuo yuu Pilisitia dokona wambupi mee bange anatu lao wasingi dupwape Sole kumuyamo doko waili pii keyange lamaiyuo raeyala pena leyami.

Dokopa nakamame mee bange enda anatu lao lakandenge kingi Aserate lenge banya tembole anda dokona Solena yanda kakupi dupwa reteyami. Retapala yuu taone Betesane lenge dokona kana kame awali lao kareyamo dokona Solena yongo yukunyi palyiyami.
Jepese wambu Giliate palenge dupwame Sole baa Pilisitia wambu dupwame pyao kumakayami doko sepala

akali paka nange porai lapome kukwa dokopa kata nyuo kimbu pyao piso yanda mako papala yuu yangeyamo dokopa yuu Betesane kando nyiyami. Kando nyepala Solena yongope banya ikinyingi dusipana yongope dupwa kondo nyepala minyuo yuu Jepese dokona kisinyi nembala peyami.
Kisinyi nembapala kuli dupwa nyepala yuu taone dokona isa tamarisiki renge dokona malu piyami. Malu pipala yuu gii yanda ipingi nyepo nenge wasaka pyuo peteyami.
